mapper.select: SELECT id, response_json AS responseJson, http_status AS httpStatus, app_code AS appCode FROM mock_api_response_fixture WHERE endpoint_id = #{endpointId} AND scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_active = 1 AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= NOW()) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= NOW()) ORDER BY priority ASC LIMIT 1
